newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Blue chips bolster Swedish shares in short session.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips bolster Swedish shares in short session.

text.p: Share prices ended higher on Thursday in holiday-thinned trade, underpinned by gains in drug company Astra and telecoms group Ericsson.
The Stockholm bourse rose 0.72 percent to 2,750.56. Turnover totalled 1.9 billion crowns in an abbreviated session ahead of the long Easter weekend.
Astra rose 4.5 crowns to 364.5 and Ericsson gained 2.5 crowns to 266.
Vehicle maker Volvo erased some gains of recent sessions which were made on a positive forecast about car sales. The share fell 3.5 crowns to 202.
Volvo ended at a record high on Wednesday after jumping 8.5 crowns.
Car safety equipment maker Autoliv also fell after sharp gains lately on news the company's planned merger with a unit of Morton International was ready. The share fell 7.5 crowns to 325.5.
Pricer, which makes bar code reading systems, leapt 15 crowns to 263.
